title: HSK 2.6 · 影响, 最近, 检查, 数字, 差不多
focus: 卖 · 选 · 句 · 影响 · 永远 · 也许 · 份 · 最近 · 换 · 狗 · 靠 · 脸 · 快乐 · 使用 · 段 · 检查 · 米 · 音乐 · 银行 · 近 · 声音 · 数 · 作用 · 许多 · 查 · 十分 · 够 · 不够 · 举行 · 不行 · 长大 · 数字 · 大量 · 好多 · 大部分 · 多么 · 什么样 · 差不多 · 大多数
body:
Lots of 'how much / how many' words: 多 many, 数 number, 够 enough, 量 amount, plus 近 near, 查 check and 音 sound. The 多-words (许多, 好多, 多么, 大多数, 差不多) are easy once you spot 多.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 多 | duō | many, much (two 夕) | 许多, 好多, 多么, 差不多, 大多数 |
| 大 | dà | big | 长大, 大量, 大部分, 大多数 |
| 数 | shù / shǔ | number / to count | 数, 数字, 大多数 |
| 够 | gòu | enough (句 gōu sound + 多) | 够, 不够 |
| 近 | jìn | near (辶 + 斤 jīn sound) | 近, 最近 |
| 查 | chá | to check (木 + 旦) | 查, 检查 |
| 音 | yīn | sound | 音乐, 声音 |
| 行 | xíng | to go; OK | 举行, 不行 |

## Watch out

- 卖 mài sell vs 买 mǎi buy: 卖 has an extra 十 on top (sell = 'buy' plus something).
- 乐 is yuè in 音乐 (music) but lè in 快乐 (happy).
- 长大: 长 is zhǎng (grow), not cháng (long).
- 永 yǒng (forever) is 水 water with an extra dot on top.

cards.Example: 这家店卖水果。 zhè jiā diàn mài shuǐguǒ: This shop sells fruit
cards.Notes: Simplified from 賣. Lookalike: 买 mǎi buy; 卖 has an extra 十 on top

cards.Example: 你选哪一个？ nǐ xuǎn nǎ yí ge: Which one do you pick?
cards.Notes: 辶 movement + 先 xiān (sound) = to pick out

cards.Example: 我说一句话。 wǒ shuō yí jù huà: Let me say a few words
cards.Notes: 勹 wrap + 口 mouth = words wrapped up together, a sentence. In 句子

cards.Example: 玩手机影响睡觉。 wán shǒujī yǐngxiǎng shuìjiào: Phones affect your sleep
cards.Notes: 影 shadow + 响 echo, sound = what follows like a shadow or echo: influence

cards.Example: 我永远爱你。 wǒ yǒngyuǎn ài nǐ: I'll love you forever
cards.Notes: 永 everlasting + 远 far = forever. 永 = 水 water with a dot on top

cards.Example: 他也许不来了。 tā yěxǔ bù lái le: Maybe he's not coming
cards.Notes: 也 also + 许 maybe, allow = perhaps

cards.Meaning: portion, share; (measure word for copies, jobs)
cards.Example: 我要一份报纸。 wǒ yào yí fèn bàozhǐ: I'd like a newspaper
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 分 fēn divide (also sound) = each person's share. 一份工作 a job

cards.Example: 你最近怎么样？ nǐ zuìjìn zěnmeyàng: How have you been lately?
cards.Notes: 最 most + 近 near = the nearest (time), recently

cards.Example: 我去换件衣服。 wǒ qù huàn jiàn yīfu: I'll go change clothes
cards.Notes: 扌 hand + 奂 huàn (sound) = to swap by hand

cards.Example: 我家有一只狗。 wǒ jiā yǒu yì zhī gǒu: We have a dog
cards.Notes: 犭 animal + 句 gōu (sound) = dog

cards.Meaning: to lean on; to rely on; next to
cards.Example: 别靠着门。 bié kào zhe mén: Don't lean on the door
cards.Notes: 告 gào (sound) + 非: to lean on. 靠窗 by the window

cards.Example: 你的脸红了。 nǐ de liǎn hóng le: Your face turned red
cards.Notes: 月 flesh, body + 佥 (sound) = face. 月 on the left of body words means flesh, not moon

cards.Example: 生日快乐！ shēngrì kuàilè: Happy birthday!
cards.Notes: 快 quick, pleased + 乐 joy = happy. 乐 is lè here, yuè in 音乐

cards.Example: 这个怎么使用？ zhège zěnme shǐyòng: How do you use this?
cards.Notes: 使 make use of (亻 + 吏) + 用 use = to use (more formal than 用)

cards.Meaning: section, period; (measure word for lengths, passages)
cards.Example: 这段时间我很忙。 zhè duàn shíjiān wǒ hěn máng: I've been busy lately
cards.Notes: Right side 殳 is a hand holding a tool: originally 'to hammer'; now a segment of road, time or text

cards.Example: 我去医院检查身体。 wǒ qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá shēntǐ: I'm getting a checkup
cards.Notes: 检 check (木 + 佥 sound) + 查 look into = to examine

cards.Example: 我去买米。 wǒ qù mǎi mǐ: I'm going to buy rice
cards.Notes: Picture of rice grains scattered around a stalk. Also meter: 一百米 100 meters. Radical in 粉, 糖

cards.Example: 我喜欢听音乐。 wǒ xǐhuan tīng yīnyuè: I like listening to music
cards.Notes: 音 sound + 乐 music (yuè here) = music

cards.Example: 我去银行。 wǒ qù yínháng: I'm going to the bank.
cards.Notes: 银 = 钅 metal + 艮; 行 is háng here but xíng in 不行

cards.Example: 我家很近。 wǒ jiā hěn jìn: My home is close
cards.Notes: 辶 walking + 斤 jīn (sound) = a short walk, near. Opposite: 远 yuǎn

cards.Example: 你的声音很好听。 nǐ de shēngyīn hěn hǎotīng: You have a nice voice
cards.Notes: 声 sound, voice + 音 sound = sound

cards.Example: 你数一数。 nǐ shǔ yi shǔ: Count them
cards.Notes: Left part + 攵 action. shù number (数字), shǔ to count (数一数)

cards.Example: 这个药有什么作用？ zhège yào yǒu shénme zuòyòng: What does this medicine do?
cards.Notes: 作 act + 用 use = the effect something has

cards.Example: 这里有许多人。 zhèlǐ yǒu xǔduō rén: There are a lot of people here
cards.Notes: 许 (here: about, much) + 多 many = many (a bit more written than 很多)

cards.Example: 我查一下这个字。 wǒ chá yíxià zhège zì: Let me look up this character
cards.Notes: 木 tree + 旦 dawn; used for checking, looking things up: 查字典

cards.Example: 我十分感谢你。 wǒ shífēn gǎnxiè nǐ: I'm extremely grateful
cards.Notes: 十 ten + 分 parts = ten out of ten, fully, so 'very'

cards.Example: 钱够不够？ qián gòu bu gòu: Is there enough money?
cards.Notes: 句 gōu (sound) + 多 many = enough

cards.Example: 时间不够了。 shíjiān bùgòu le: There's not enough time
cards.Notes: 不 not + 够 enough. 不 is said bú before 4th tone

cards.Example: 明天举行比赛。 míngtiān jǔxíng bǐsài: The match is held tomorrow
cards.Notes: 举 raise, hold up + 行 carry out = to hold an event

cards.Meaning: no way; won't do; not good
cards.Example: 这样不行。 zhèyàng bùxíng: This won't work
cards.Notes: 不 not + 行 OK, will do = no good. 行 is xíng here, háng in 银行

cards.Example: 我在北京长大。 wǒ zài Běijīng zhǎngdà: I grew up in Beijing
cards.Notes: 长 grow (zhǎng here) + 大 big = to grow big, grow up

cards.Example: 这个数字是多少？ zhège shùzì shì duōshao: What's this number?
cards.Notes: 数 number (shù here) + 字 written character = a written number, digit

cards.Example: 他喝了大量的水。 tā hē le dàliàng de shuǐ: He drank lots of water
cards.Notes: 大 big + 量 amount = a large quantity

cards.Example: 我有好多作业。 wǒ yǒu hǎoduō zuòyè: I have tons of homework
cards.Notes: 好 (here: very) + 多 many = lots

cards.Example: 大部分人都来了。 dàbùfen rén dōu lái le: Most people came
cards.Notes: 大 big + 部分 part = the big part, most

cards.Example: 这里多么漂亮啊！ zhèlǐ duōme piàoliang a: How beautiful it is here!
cards.Notes: 多 much + 么 (suffix) = how very…! Used in exclamations

cards.Example: 你喜欢什么样的人？ nǐ xǐhuan shénmeyàng de rén: What kind of person do you like?
cards.Notes: 什么 what + 样 appearance = what kind

cards.Example: 我们差不多高。 wǒmen chàbuduō gāo: We're about the same height
cards.Notes: 差 differ + 不多 not much = differing by little, almost

cards.Example: 大多数人喜欢吃。 dàduōshù rén xǐhuan chī: Most people like it
cards.Notes: 大 big + 多数 majority (多 many + 数 number) = the vast majority
